The Immersive Shooting Screen delivers a cutting-edge, four-player competitive shooting experience that blends realism with advanced digital interaction. Designed to simulate diverse hunting environments and high-action scenarios, it uses vivid 3D graphics and responsive targets to create an authentic shooting atmosphere. Whether you're aiming in a lush reed marsh, a towering mountain range, or a fast-paced hostage rescue mission, players are fully immersed in every moment. Perfect for both entertainment and skill-based training, this interactive screen takes virtual shooting to a whole new level.



>> Features of Immersive Shooting Screen:


  • 4-Player Competitive Mode

Simultaneous multiplayer experience allows up to four players to compete or collaborate in real-time.

  • Diverse Game Scenarios

Includes ten richly designed environments such as: Reed Marsh Shooting Range，Mountain Peaks, Tropical Savannah, Chasing Hunt, Olympic Skeet Shooting, Hostage Rescue, Underwater Hunt, Speedboat Fishing, Bullseye Shooting, And More…

  • Advanced 3D Graphics

Realistic animal behaviors and detailed environments heighten player engagement and provide a highly immersive experience.

  • Randomized Target Paths

Animals and objects appear and move unpredictably, making each round unique and challenging.

  • Responsive Sensor and Gun Interface

Precision tracking for shots, with immediate visual and audio feedback for immersive realism.



>> Product Advantages:


Realistic Gameplay

Utilizes next-gen 3D rendering to simulate natural wildlife movement, terrain, and action sequences.


Educational and Recreational Value

Great for both entertainment and teaching responsible shooting, aiming techniques, and reflex improvement.


Multiplayer Social Fun

Ideal for group entertainment, fostering competition and cooperation among players of all skill levels.

Wide Scenario Variety

From wild hunting simulations to tactical rescue missions, players can explore multiple genres and challenges in one system.


Easy Integration and Setup

User-friendly software and hardware setup allows for fast deployment in arcades, training centers, or event venues.



>> Product Applications


  • Family Entertainment Centers & Arcades

A crowd-pleasing, interactive attraction with high replay value and competitive appeal.

  • Theme Parks and Experience Zones

Adds interactive and action-packed content for visitors of all ages.

  • Military & Police Simulation Training

Offers tactical training potential in hostage rescue and target recognition scenarios.

  • Sports Bars and E-sport Lounges

Provides a dynamic social game that can drive traffic and create an immersive gaming hub.

  • Mobile Events & Pop-Up Exhibits

Portable and customizable, perfect for short-term installations or brand activations.



>> FAQs for Immersive Shooting Screen:


Q1: How many players can use the system at once?

A1: The system supports up to 4 players simultaneously, promoting teamwork or competitive matches.


Q2: What kind of weapons or controllers are used?

A2: Players use specially designed simulation guns or infrared controllers that are synced with the screen for accurate targeting and feedback.


Q3: Are the environments pre-installed or downloadable?

A3: The product comes with a set of built-in environments. Additional scenarios may be available via updates or customization packages.


Q4: Is the gameplay suitable for children?

A4: Yes, the difficulty and content can be adjusted to ensure a safe and fun experience for younger players.


Q5: Does the system require internet access?

A5: Basic gameplay runs offline, but updates, leaderboards, or online modes may require an internet connection.
